QUOTE: "else is_explicitly_allowed (allow list) → approved" and "The allow list only skips a prompt."
VERDICT: MISS
WHY: The answer says the allow list only skips a prompt and places it inside check_approval. But it never says the allow list is consulted only from there, in a different file than the deny check. The "only from check_approval, in a different file" part isn't stated.
